scope: Pre-execution source and equation review by the single execution owner; independently coded tests/auditor, no second agent or claim of external review.
construction: Whole-start, temporally aligned sensor-to-load empirical interval with fixed nearest-neighbour witness; no hyperparameter search.

equations.fit: 5 whole starts, fixed k=16 nearest neighbours; sensor standardization floor0.01
equations.calibration: one held-out yaw-left start; radius=max absolute residual, distance envelope=max16th-neighbour distance
equations.test: disjoint yaw-right start plus all11 learned-policy challenge starts; failures retained
equations.declarations: geometry valid and inside calibration distance; loaded iff lower>=0.05bw, unloaded iff upper<0.01bw
equations.decision: zero false declarations and interval misses plus>=90percent loaded/unloaded recall on held-out teacher start; no deployment even if this screen passes

core_contracts: load and position transitions require25consecutive qualified measurements
unknown is not unloaded and cannot advance transfer/unload/stand
sensor packet is post-step; decisions apply to the NEXT control step, preserving original20s window
surface memory requires independently supplied current uncertainty, not assumed fixed feet
audit enforces original20s window, every-tick safety and exact action/filter/finger invariants
synthetic fixture never returns physical success
remaining_not_implemented: new upright-lean furniture and geometry admission
resource_review: one45second total CPU validation parent,40GiBAS,1CPU,source/input hashes before tests, no simulation/GPU or retries
